CustomMetadata.label: Account Create Case For Account - After Insert

values.value: Migrated from ATFE_CreateCaseForAccount trigger (after insert, now Inactive - see the trigger's own meta.xml - rather than deleted): creates a Sales Ops review Case for new ATI Accounts, owned by the region/sub-region's support queue, for users with a valid price book region (NA/EMEA/APAC) or the Customer Support Profile. Retains the UtilSODOFlags.skip_caseTrigges hand-rolled bypass in-code since that flag is also read by other, unconverted Case triggers (case_events_handling, SFSupport_case_events) - see conversion notes.
